name: Senjin Otome -Makina ni Yadorishi Kokoro ga Negau wa...-
original_name: 戦刃乙女 －マキナに宿りし心が願うは…－
source:
Takato lives alone since his parents are hardly in the house due to work. He enjoys a pleasant school life with his osananajimi Akane and best friend Shuuichirou. One day, he received a delivery the size of a coffin from his parents, inside of which was a sleeping naked girl. She was accompanied by a note telling him to seek out the truth with her. At that time, the girl opened her eyes and his fate began to change.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
由于父母因工作几乎不在家，高人独自一人生活。他与小花七美茜和最好的朋友修一郎一起享受着愉快的学校生活。有一天，他收到了父母送来的一个棺材大小的货物，里面是一个熟睡的裸体女孩。她还附上了一张纸条，告诉他和她一起寻找真相。就在那时，女孩睁开了眼睛，他的命运开始改变。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
